sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Bharat Kumar Dixit Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajnish Ojha Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to enlarge her on bail in Case Crime No.317 of 2022 under Section 363, 366, 504, 376 (3) IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act,
PS Gurubuxganj, District Raebareli.
Learned counsel for the applicant has invited attention of this Court to the statement of the prosecutrix made under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in which there is no allegation of rape against the applicant.
She rather deposed in her statement before the court that she has gone out of her free will to the house of the applicant.
The Medical has also not been conducted.
The applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is in jail since 18.06.2022.
Shri Rajnish Ojha, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has opposed the bail on behalf of the complainant and has submitted that it is not a fit case for bail.

On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail and submitted that it is a case of heinous crime and the application for bail is liable to be rejected.

Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case and statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 Cr.P.C., where there is no allegation of the rape leveled against the applicant, it is a fit case for bail.

Let the applicant Sunil be released on bail in the above case crime number on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that she shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through her counsel.

In case of her absence, without sufficient cause,
the trial court may proceed against her under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure her presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against her, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law.

It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The Trial Court shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led unaffected by anything in this order.
Order Date :- 23.3.2023
Raj  Sunil vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
